tagline: State-driven REST API that simulates dynamic system behavior through evolving internal states.

details.overview: Emotionally Unstable Coffee API is a backend project that simulates a coffee machine with changing internal states such as mood, burnout, cleanliness, and caffeine levels. Instead of returning fixed responses, the API evolves based on user interactions, demonstrating state management, custom HTTP responses, and creative backend design.
engineering_challenges: Designing a state-driven system where API behavior changes over time
Managing multiple internal states and their interactions
Implementing dynamic HTTP responses based on system conditions
Creating predictable logic while maintaining non-deterministic behavior
key_features: State-driven engine with mood, burnout, caffeine, and cleanliness tracking
Dynamic responses that evolve based on usage patterns
Custom HTTP status codes and response headers
Preview endpoint to simulate complete system behavior
Interactive endpoints that modify internal system state
what_i_learned: Designing stateful backend systems instead of traditional CRUD APIs
Using HTTP status codes and headers beyond standard implementations
Modeling complex system behavior through backend logic
Balancing creative ideas with practical software engineering concepts
